m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I hear your challenge and accept! Enter and face your doom!
<ITALICS>As the sound of the bell fades, the gate to the Red Thorn Tower opens, beckoning you inside. </ITALICS>
You may be no knight, but let it not be said I'm not fair.
And I'll fairly throw you into my dungeon when you lose!
Froudlings take you, Wizard, I am beaten!
As I still have my own honor, you should free the knights below in the dungeons, lest they starve.
Lord Thornwhip sent me a new toy! A Wizard toy, not knight! Come here...
<ITALICS>The smelly brute drops a heavy ring of keys with a thunk. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You use the keys to free the trapped knights. </ITALICS
Well fought! Thank you for freeing me, young Wizard! I'll head back to Caliburn to rest up and speak to you there.
By Gamma, that's better! Many thanks to you, kind stranger! I too will head to Caliburn and join the knights there.
A remarkable feat, good Wizard! Merle Ambrose has taught you well.
You must go to the Red Thorn Tower and ring the Bell outside it, to challenge the false knight Sir Terrence Thornwhip.
Go inside, trounce Sir Terrence, and free any knights he has in his dungeon! Let me know when you succeed!
Ring the Bell outside the Red Thorn Tower to challenge Sir Terrence to a duel. Defeat him, and free any knights he holds hostage.
